title: El-Rich 2004: LG(L1) EMG in upright standing vs hand load 0-380 N, in front or on the sides
subcategory: upright static load holding EMG (%MVC), load magnitude and position

quantity.name: normalised EMG
quantity.definition: surface EMG RMS over the 4-s trial, band-pass 10-400 Hz, averaged left/right; normalised to the largest EMG of that muscle recorded in the whole session (standing MVCs in cardinal planes against a harness, prone extension, isometric forward bending with load); paper's unit '% MVC'

source.authors: El-Rich M, Shirazi-Adl A, Arjmand N
source.sample: 15 healthy males, no recent back complications
source.citation_note: DOI not printed in the PDF; not filled

protocol.summary: Upright standing, head straight, hands extended in the gravity direction close to the body, holding 0, 90, 180, 280 or 380 N either symmetrically on the sides (two dumbbells) or in front (bar); randomised trials. Load magnitude and location had no significant effect on posture (skin markers T1-S1).
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to a 177 cm, 74 kg, 30-year-old male
Upright standing, arms hanging, no trunk flexion
Hand load = stated total force: bar in both hands in front of the thighs, or one dumbbell per hand at the sides
Compare predicted activation (%) of the fascicles under the electrode (left/right averaged) with mean %MVC
protocol.notes: Model results in the paper (muscle forces, disc loads, stability) are model output and not extracted. Back-muscle EMG rose significantly with load held in front, not on the sides; abdominals stayed low.

extraction.uncertainty: ±1 %MVC on mean and SD (embedded 300-ppi raster, 5.75 px per %MVC; gridlines 20/40/60/80 recovered at 80.1/59.9/40.1 and 80.2/59.8/40.1)
extraction.check_notes: Mean = midpoint of the error-bar caps and SD = half the cap-to-cap length (symmetric bars), found by pixel analysis of the extracted figure; independent check: LG square-marker centres 25.5/30.3/33.7/39.0 (front 90-380 N) vs cap midpoints 25.4/30.2/33.5/38.9. Bars overlapped by the legend (MF 0 N front, IC 0 N sides) were read from their caps below the legend.
